dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おはよー、お兄ちゃん♪」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning, oniichan!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp:
｛まぶ／眩｝しい朝日の中に顔をつっこむと、｛まぶた／瞼｝の上から
の光でも目が痛んだ。
dialogues.en:
The dazzling morning sun makes my eyes hurt even when
they're closed.
dialogues.text:
The dazzling morning sun makes my eyes hurt even when
they're closed.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　なんで制服着てないの？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Why aren't you wearing your uniform?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Why aren't you wearing your uniform?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「え、ああ。音夢が倒れたんで、看病してたら
　朝になってた」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, yeah. I was taking care of Nemu after she fainted, and
when I noticed, it was already morning."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, yeah. I was taking care of Nemu after she fainted, and
when I noticed, it was already morning."

dialogues.jp:
目をこすって、昨日からそのまま着っぱなしの
服をひっぱる。
dialogues.en:
Rubbing my eyes, I tug briefly at the uniform from
yesterday.
dialogues.text:
Rubbing my eyes, I tug briefly at the uniform from
yesterday.

dialogues.jp: 「悪いけど、今日は休むよ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, but I've got to sleep."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, but I've got to sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……音夢ちゃんが倒れた？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu-chan fainted?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu-chan fainted?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp:
桜の花びらを吐いたとはいえないし、音夢自身、
とりあえず落ち着きを取り戻して今は寝ている。
dialogues.en:
I can't exactly say she spilled cherry petals from her
mouth, and she's sleeping comfortably now.
dialogues.text:
I can't exactly say she spilled cherry petals from her
mouth, and she's sleeping comfortably now.

dialogues.jp:
本当は救急車でも呼ぼうと思ったのだが、あん
まりな状態なので様子を見ていたのだが……。
dialogues.en:
I almost called an ambulance, but there was quite a
situation, so I was just watching over her.
dialogues.text:
I almost called an ambulance, but there was quite a
situation, so I was just watching over her.

dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり病院に連れて行って、検査次第では
　明日も休むかも知れない」
dialogues.en:
"I'll take her to a hospital later, and I may not go to
school tomorrow depending on the result of her check-up."
dialogues.text:
"I'll take her to a hospital later, and I may not go to
school tomorrow depending on the result of her check-up."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「寝てるの？」
dialogues.en: "Slept?"
dialogues.text: "Slept?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、寝てるよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, she did."
dialogues.text: "Yes, she did."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うんん。お兄ちゃんがだよ」
dialogues.en: "No, I mean you, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "No, I mean you, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「？　あぁ、俺か……いや」
dialogues.en: "Oh, me? Not really..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, me? Not really..."

dialogues.jp: いまいち緩慢な動きで首を振る。
dialogues.en: I shake my head slowly.
dialogues.text: I shake my head slowly.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢を病院に連れて行ってから寝るよ」
dialogues.en: "I'll sleep after I take Nemu to a hospital."
dialogues.text: "I'll sleep after I take Nemu to a hospital."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「分かった。なんかあったら連絡してね」
dialogues.en: "Okay. If you need me, call me any time."
dialogues.text: "Okay. If you need me, call me any time."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.jp:
さくらを見送って、｛あくび／欠伸｝をかみ殺しながら家に
戻る。
dialogues.en:
After seeing Sakura off, I go back to the house while
swallowing a yawn.
dialogues.text:
After seeing Sakura off, I go back to the house while
swallowing a yawn.

dialogues.jp: 「……はい、宜しくお願いします」
dialogues.en: "Yes, thank you."
dialogues.text: "Yes, thank you."

dialogues.jp:
電話でタクシーを呼んだ後、ソファーに身体を
投げ出す。
dialogues.en: After I phone for a taxi, I throw myself on the couch.
dialogues.text: After I phone for a taxi, I throw myself on the couch.

dialogues.jp: かったるい、と言うのもかったるい。
dialogues.en: It's too much of a pain to even say it's a pain.
dialogues.text: It's too much of a pain to even say it's a pain.

dialogues.jp: 床に散らばった桜の花びら。
dialogues.en: There are lots of cherry petals on the floor.
dialogues.text: There are lots of cherry petals on the floor.

dialogues.jp: それを手のひらですくう。
dialogues.en: I scoop them up with my hands.
dialogues.text: I scoop them up with my hands.

dialogues.jp:
ぱらぱら、と指の隙間から舞い落ちる、桜の花
びら。
dialogues.en: The cherry petals sprinkle down through my fingers.
dialogues.text: The cherry petals sprinkle down through my fingers.

dialogues.jp:
口の中におかしな感触がして、それを舌で探り
当てて外にだす。
dialogues.en:
My mouth feels something strange, so I push it out with my
tongue.
dialogues.text:
My mouth feels something strange, so I push it out with my
tongue.

dialogues.jp: 「これは」
dialogues.en: "This is..."
dialogues.text: "This is..."

dialogues.jp:
指の腹にはりついたそれは、紛れもなく、桜の
花びらだった。
dialogues.en:
The thing sticking on my fingertip is a cherry petal, beyond
doubt.
dialogues.text:
The thing sticking on my fingertip is a cherry petal, beyond
doubt.

dialogues.jp: 特にこれといった異常は認められません。
dialogues.en: There's nothing wrong with her.
dialogues.text: There's nothing wrong with her.

dialogues.jp:
痩せすぎなので、季節の変わり目に体調を崩し
たのかも知れませんね。
dialogues.en:
She is too thin, which could upset her health in a seasonal
change.
dialogues.text:
She is too thin, which could upset her health in a seasonal
change.

dialogues.jp: ただし、検査はしてみましょう。
dialogues.en:
However, just in case, let's do some further examination on
her.
dialogues.text:
However, just in case, let's do some further examination on
her.

dialogues.jp: 入院です――。
dialogues.en: She requires hospitalization.
dialogues.text: She requires hospitalization.

dialogues.jp:
そんな言葉が脳にこびりついたまま、俺はいつ
のまにか自分の部屋のベッドに寝ていて。
dialogues.en:
As the doctor's words run through my mind again, I realize
I'm sleeping in my own bed.
dialogues.text:
As the doctor's words run through my mind again, I realize
I'm sleeping in my own bed.

dialogues.jp: 深い眠りに落ちた……。
dialogues.en: I drift into a deep sleep.
dialogues.text: I drift into a deep sleep.

dialogues.jp: ◆異常は認められません◆
dialogues.en: ◆The doctor says she's OK◆
dialogues.text: ◆The doctor says she's OK◆

dialogues.jp:
徹夜で音夢を看病した次の日、さくらが家に来
る。
dialogues.en:
The day after I took care of Nemu through the night, Sakura
visited my house.
dialogues.text:
The day after I took care of Nemu through the night, Sakura
visited my house.

dialogues.jp:
事情を話すと、お兄ちゃんも気をつけてね、と
身体の心配をしてもらった。
dialogues.en:
When I told her the situation, she said to me that I should
be careful with my health as well.
dialogues.text:
When I told her the situation, she said to me that I should
be careful with my health as well.

dialogues.jp:
そして、音夢を病院に連れて行こうとしたとき、
ふと、自分の口からも桜の花びらがこぼれてき
たことにショックを受けた……。
dialogues.en:
When I was about to take Nemu to the hospital, I saw cherry
petals spilling out of my mouth, which gave me a shock...
dialogues.text:
When I was about to take Nemu to the hospital, I saw cherry
petals spilling out of my mouth, which gave me a shock...
